notes.subject: kros
notes.rationale: אף as i min 'nuz/naral', bihain i min kros — 'nuz bilong kros' i no inap go stret long Tok Pisin

notes.subject: mipela
notes.rationale: Hebri sufiks -נו long ותרדפנו i makim objekt; Tok Pisin i nidim tok 'mipela' olgeta

notes.subject: yu karamapim mipela / yu karamapim yu yet
notes.rationale: סכותה באף: sampela i ritim 'yu karamapim mipela wantaim kros', sampela 'yu karamapim yu yet' (ylt, bsb)

translation: Yu karamapim mipela wantaim kros, na yu bihainim mipela; yu kilim i dai, yu no sori.
